usedFor: Browse AI extracts web data, and Microsoft Excel stores it when “Table Export” runs “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “Table Export” in Browse AI, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each completed export from Browse AI adds a row to your Excel table, keeping scraped results in one place.

watchOut: “Update Row” sits beside “Add Row To Table” here, so pick the one that fits history versus one latest row.
